text: In 1735, deep in the Pine Barrens of New Jersey, a mother cursed her thirteenth child.
Legend says it grew hooves, wings and a tail... and escaped up the chimney.
Two hundred years later, a trapper sits alone in his shack in those same pines.
Something lands on his roof. Hooves.
A shadow with wings slides past the window.
Then the scraping moves to the chimney.
Soot falls into the fire. He leans in and looks up.
It left through a chimney. It knows the way back in.
